transcript.message: Helvetia Werkstoffe, accounts department. How can I help you?
Hello, my name is Klaus Mueller from Alpina Tech. I am calling about an overdue invoice.  We received a reminder, but we already paid four thousand two hundred francs on the 27th of July.

An overdue invoice you've already paid — I can look into that.  First I need to confirm your identity.
 
Could you please tell me the email address associated with your account?
Thank you.  Could you please tell me the phone number associated with your account?
Thank you.   Could you please tell me your date of birth?
I was born on the 12th of March 1974.

I can see the invoice from the twentieth of June,  INV twenty twenty-six, zero zero one three,  showing as overdue with no payment recorded against it.
 
You mentioned you paid four thousand two hundred francs on the twenty-seventh of July.   Is that the exact amount and date you transferred?   It is fine to check your banking app — I will wait.
Yes, that is correct.  Four thousand two hundred francs on the 27th of July.

A payment matching those details was found and appears to cover the invoice.   A person will confirm it within twenty-four hours,  and you need do nothing else.
 
The payer address on the payment is recorded as "Alpina Tech,  Bahnhofstrasse 45, 8001 Zurich".   Is that correct, or is it a typo or have you moved?

Thank you for confirming.   I have noted that the company has not moved.   A colleague will review the payment allocation and the address details together and will correct any discrepancies.   They will be in touch if anything further is needed.
 
Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
